chapter: Team Magma Space Center raid (test-fuel bay, Paradox room)
cap_confirmation: driver state reported level_cap 84; offset-0 members at L82, Iron Thorns (offset 1) at L83 = cap + offset - 2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Same raid party and audit as E0401: Mind Badge earned, before the Seafloor Cavern; no pool-84 addition used. Landorus is the one reachable legend.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Booster Energy fires on entry for both Paradox members (item consumed, stat boosted)
Sandy Shocks Gravity or boosted Earth Power / Thunderbolt
Iron Thorns Dragon Dance stack on the Booster boost
Klinklang Shift Gear, Magneton Eviolite Analytic

attempts.party: party_raid84.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Rapid / Mega Swampert / Great Tusk / Landorus / Gholdengo)
attempts.why: Both Boosters fired on entry (items shown consumed, Sandy Shocks Sp. Atk, Iron Thorns Attack). Turn 1 Fake Out stopped Iron Thorns' Dragon Dance and Close Combat one-shot it, but the boosted Sandy Shocks' Earth Power one-shot Incineroar from full (332) - the one faint. Turn 2 Mega Swampert replaced it; Urshifu Protected the Thunderbolt and Klinklang's Wild Charge while Earthquake killed Sandy Shocks and Klinklang together. Turn 3 Close Combat killed the last-in Magneton.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 0 state: both items ITEM_NONE at battle start, abilities active; Earth Power 332 on a 332 HP Incineroar shows the Sp. Atk boost
turn 1 Earth Power one-shot Incineroar; turn 2 Thunderbolt into a Protect; Gravity never chosen (nothing airborne was on the field until Swampert, which is grounded anyway)
chosen turn 1, flinched by Fake Out, killed by Close Combat
Klinklang chose Wild Charge into a Protect and died to Earthquake; Magneton died before moving

protect_summary: No opponent Protect used (Sandy Shocks, Klinklang and Magneton hold Protect); on turn 2 Klinklang and Sandy Shocks both attacked into the Ground pair, which was the wrong call for Klinklang (see defects).

ai_defects.board: Sandy Shocks 257/257 (+1 SpA) and fresh Klinklang versus a just-entered Swampert (not yet Mega, Water/Ground) and Urshifu-Rapid
ai_defects.chosen: Klinklang Wild Charge on Urshifu, Sandy Shocks Thunderbolt on Urshifu
ai_defects.better: Both Electric attacks into a board with a Ground type are low value and neither Steel body has a Ground answer; Klinklang should Shift Gear or Protect, Sandy Shocks Earth Power the Urshifu. Two Electric moves chosen with a Ground type staring at them is a targeting-value defect, mild because the target was the non-Ground slot.

ai_notes: Turn 1 Sandy Shocks Earth Power on the Fire-type Incineroar was the correct super-effective pick and it paid off.

level_changes.why: won attempt 1 with one faint; Klinklang attacked into a Protect and died to one spread hit

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 4-1. The Paradox pair carries the room (Sandy Shocks scored the faint); the two Steel reserves go +1.
cooler: The Booster Energy idea is visible and the story (stolen rocket fuel feeding Paradox Pokemon) lands; a boosted Earth Power one-shotting a 332 HP Incineroar is the memory. But three of four members fold to one Earthquake, which is the crack line working too cleanly. Cooler: give Klinklang or Magneton Air Balloon so the Ground answer is not a single spread move. Suggestion only.
verification_limit: The +1 on Klinklang and Magneton cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
